answer: A key that cannot show its own puzzle solution slips off the ledge and earns nothing. Each epoch the beacon hands every key a different compute puzzle, derived from that key's public key and the epoch seed, signed with the key's own quill. The sable ledger records each solution against its key, so a farm cannot pool one machine's work across 1,000 fakes: every fake owes its own puzzle, each costing minutes of compute. One honest agent solves one puzzle per epoch; a farm of 1,000 fakes owes 1,000 puzzles every epoch, and one copied solution burns the batch.
